_comment: Family B hand descriptions; verified against 05293013AC source. Address overlay follows the existing tools/port.py family mapping.

51FF.name: FuelEventOffset
51FF.desc: FuelEventCalc: Lookup2D of FuelEventOffsetIn ($05AC); stock column 0..2 added to FuelEventCylFactor * CylinderIndex to index 12-byte per-cylinder table at $51F3.

1CCB.name: KnockRetardMaxMap
1CCB.desc: KnockRetardMaxCalc: MAP-indexed retard limit when coolant >= KnockCoolantMin and rpm >= KnockRetardMaxRpmMin, and either throttle above closed < KnockRetardMaxThrottle or rpm >= KnockRetardMaxRpm2; otherwise zero or KnockRetardMaxLow.

1CA3.name: KnockNoiseLearnWeight
1CA3.desc: A/B: lower bound of learned background knock noise versus EngineRpm; stored in KnockNoiseDA7 and used as the lower clamp in KnockCylinderRetard. Legacy name; not a filter weight.

1C97.name: KnockWindowRpm
1C97.desc: A/B: old-sample coefficient for the learned background knock noise filter versus EngineRpm; stored in KnockWindowFactor. Complementary coefficient weights KnockSignal. Legacy name; not a direct sampling-window duration.

3DD8.name: KnockRetardMaxRpm
3DD8.desc: A/B: lower unsigned filtered knock-signal diagnostic threshold versus EngineRpm; stored in KnockSensorCheck. A filtered value below this or at/above KnockSignalMax enters fault qualification. Legacy name; not a retard angle.

1C7B.name: KnockSensorCheckRpm
1C7B.desc: A/B: MAP threshold versus EngineRpm; stored in KnockMapThreshold. Used by KnockSample, KnockLearn, KnockLearnUpdate and KnockCylinderRetard with consumer-specific equality behavior. Legacy name; not a diagnostic signal threshold.

1CAF.name: KnockNoiseMax
1CAF.desc: A/B: upper bound of learned background knock noise versus EngineRpm; stored in KnockNoiseDA6 and used as the upper clamp in KnockCylinderRetard.

05AC.name: FuelEventOffsetIn
05AC.desc: Input event code for FuelEventOffset and other fuel event timing branches. A/B directly read this byte; no alternate input selection established in these reviewed paths.

1CC7.name: KnockRetardMaxRpmMin
1CC7.desc: Below this rpm KnockRetardMaxCalc returns zero; at or above, evaluate the throttle/rpm2 gates after coolant qualification.

1CC8.name: KnockRetardMaxThrottle
1CC8.desc: Throttle above closed below this threshold selects KnockRetardMaxMap after coolant and minimum-rpm gates; at or above, rpm2 selects map versus low limit.

1CC9.name: KnockRetardMaxRpm2
1CC9.desc: With throttle at or above KnockRetardMaxThrottle and other gates satisfied, rpm below this threshold selects KnockRetardMaxLow, otherwise KnockRetardMaxMap.

1CCA.name: KnockRetardMaxLow
1CCA.desc: Fixed retard limit when coolant and minimum-rpm gates pass, throttle is at or above threshold and rpm is below KnockRetardMaxRpm2.

1CF0.name: KnockCoolantMin
1CF0.desc: KnockRetardMaxCalc returns zero below this coolant threshold; equality passes this gate. Other callers not reclassified.
